subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Sleep is not only a personal weakness.”?
options: It helped students see habits that had become automatic.
It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.
But the real city still has weather, habits, emotions, and surprises.
Design must ask what a place already means before adding attention.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It helped students see habits that had become automatic.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Sleep is not only a personal weakness. It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「But the real city still has weather, habits, emotions, and surprises.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Sleep is not only a personal weakness. It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.」，答案為「It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is affected by design, habits, stress, and social pressure.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
